clozeStyle.title: Cloze style
clozeStyle.description: Choose highlights, underlines or brackets. Hover to reveal answers. Changes preview immediately; save to keep them, or close without saving to restore the previous settings.

clozeColor.title: Cloze color
clozeColor.description: Text color uses --b3-theme-on-background; highlight color uses --b3-protyle-inline-mark-background. Both are fixed. Variable color accepts a CSS variable name or var(...); custom color uses a color picker. Defaults to text color.

bracketStyle.title: Bracket style
bracketStyle.description: Applies to bracket clozes. Blank width follows the original text length.

customLeftBracket.title: Custom left symbol
customLeftBracket.description: Used with custom brackets. Multiple characters are allowed.

customRightBracket.title: Custom right symbol
customRightBracket.description: Used with custom brackets. Multiple characters are allowed.

pdfStyle.title: PDF export style
pdfStyle.description: Follow toggle: hide when enabled, show when disabled. Highlight or normal text: always show answers and reveal hidden blocks. Close any existing export preview and export again after changing settings.

pdfClearHighlight.title: Clear highlights when cloze is off
pdfClearHighlight.description: Applies only when PDF export follows the cloze toggle and cloze is off. Disabled by default to keep highlights. Enable to export highlighted text as normal text.

css.title: Custom Style
css.description: Advanced styling: choose Custom CSS to control highlight clozes here. Presets control other cloze styles. Block cloze styles remain customizable. Use !important where needed. The PDF policy overrides highlight hiding.

reset.title: Reset Settings
reset.description: Reset all settings to default values
reset.label: Reset
